last_committed_milestone.title: Phase 11 legacy engine implementation relocation
notes: Moved legacy XTTS and Voxtral implementation modules behind adapter package boundaries.
Verified no remaining app/plugins/tests imports of engines_voxtral or xtts_utils.
Kept legacy implementation details encapsulated behind the Studio 2.0 plugin/TTS Server boundary.

active_constraints: Use Memory/rules.md as the shared source of truth for Codex and Antigravity/Gemini session behavior.
Use .agent/rules.md and .agent/rules/* for repo-persistent normative guidance.
Codex is lead architect, reviewer, integrator, verifier, checkpoint owner, and manual-QA caller.
Use Antigravity/Gemini for bounded non-trivial worker tasks to minimize token usage; Codex reviews, integrates, verifies, and commits.
Use JSON-style prompts for Antigravity/Gemini handoffs.
Codex should do small local fixes directly when delegating would cost more tokens than the fix.
Codex owns project direction and should give constructive pushback when shortcuts would weaken boundaries, hide v2 failures, or deepen legacy coupling.
Push only from stable checkpoints or when explicitly asked.
Durable Studio 2.0 state belongs in SQLite, not state.json.
Job status is the source of truth for phase; progress is only numeric position.
Plugin metadata should remain canonical in plugins/*/manifest.json and plugins/*/settings_schema.json.
App-level behavior decisions should be plugin-behavior driven, not hardcoded to specific engine ids such as xtts or voxtral.

Main app code should not mention specific engine names; engine names belong only in plugins, plugin manifests/schemas, plugin-internal adapters, meaningful tests, or explicitly approved migration scripts.
Do not preserve legacy support or backwards compatibility for v1/beta behavior unless the user explicitly approves a specific exception.
xtts_audio is engine-test residue, not protected project storage; it may be removed once references are migrated or deleted.
Use Antigravity/Gemini for bounded non-trivial worker tasks; Codex must verify and checkpoint coherent results locally.
Do not reintroduce USE_TTS_SERVER, USE_STUDIO_ORCHESTRATOR, or USE_V2_* runtime switches.
Do not start Phase 12 until Phase 11 is complete.
phase_11_guidance: Phase 11 audit entry point is plans/phase_11_audit.md.
Phase 11 active task board is plans/implementation/phase_11_remaining_work.md.
Phase 11 completed work log is plans/implementation/phase_11_completed_work.md.

User-reported regressions are fixed in code and tests, with manual app verification still pending: Settings engine test without default voice, Library /api/projects load time, chapter render enqueue blank enablement message, duplicate React key warning for duplicate model IDs, plugin test_text handling, failed queue timestamps, and mixed render error-detail propagation.

Mixed chapter render may still fail in the live app, but the generic `Mixed synthesis returned failed` clobbering path has been fixed and an end-to-end API regression now exercises `/api/processing_queue` through the orchestrator and mixed handler successfully in tests.
Startup now performs a conservative orphaned TTS Server cleanup sweep, and watchdog shutdown waits are shorter to avoid long hangs at `Stopping reloader process`.
The TTS Server watchdog now writes a transient runtime marker under `TRANSIENT_DIR` and clears it on clean shutdown so startup can verify leftover processes before killing them.
The bridge/registry cleanup, direct handler generator migration, and initial plugin behavior foundation are complete.
The broader orchestration cutover has been locally verified with the affected backend suite and diff check.
Legacy dashboard labels and default-setting names have been generalized without changing the existing xtts_audio storage path.
plans/phases/phase_11_v2_only_runtime_cleanup.md needs to reflect the hard-cutover direction: no engine names in main app code, no legacy compatibility preservation, and xtts_audio removable.
Remaining engine-name references should be handled as classified cleanup slices, not broad rewrites.
Legacy Voxtral and XTTS implementation modules have been relocated behind engine adapter package boundaries.
All v2 cutover flags have been removed from app/tests; Studio 2.0 behavior should be the only runtime behavior.
Classify each legacy/fallback item by path, kind, current references, runtime impact, desired outcome, risk, and verification notes.
Treat silent v1/in-process production fallback as the core cleanup target.
Keep migration scripts and compatibility readers where they protect existing user data.
Make service failures visible and actionable instead of routing silently to older runtime paths.
Direct legacy generator calls have been removed from app/jobs/handlers and app/orchestration/tasks; handlers now route through the Studio 2.0 bridge.
Legacy generator helpers remain encapsulated inside XTTS/Voxtral plugin implementations and low-level engine utility tests.
Treat stored legacy fields such as voxtral_model or voxtral_voice_id as migration inputs only; do not build new app logic around engine-specific field names.
Serialize bridge-backed synthesis jobs one at a time until the TTS server proves it can safely handle concurrency.

codeql_context.current_policy: Defer CodeQL triage to the security verification track unless a finding directly blocks the current task.
codeql_context.local_annotations: codeql-annotations.json, if present, is informational and should not distract from Phase 11 audit work unless intentionally used.

next_logical_steps: Map the next user-reported app problem to plans/implementation/phase_11_remaining_work.md.
Fix the smallest behavior path that resolves the problem.
Update the task board when a task is completed, deferred, or split.
Keep transient runtime markers in the shared scratch root rather than in the database or Memory.
Checkpoint the single-flight scheduler change once the focused tests and integration slice remain green.
